stemMd: A shop sells 30% of its stock on Monday, then half the remaining stock on Tuesday. What fraction of the original stock remains?
explanationMd: After Monday 70% remains. Halving that leaves 35% of the original stock. The Tuesday fraction applies to the remainder.

distractorRationale.a: Multiplies the two sold fractions rather than the remaining fractions.
distractorRationale.b: Subtracts both percentages directly from the original whole.
